description: Do you love to decorate in and around your home for the Christmas season? Are you sick and tired of using cheap, generic storage containers that fall apart or get mixed in with all the other items you're storing? Hearth & Harbor Christmas Tree Storage Bag to the rescue! SAFE STORAGING Hearth & Harbor's durable and breathable Christmas tree bags with zipper closure helps shield Christmas trees from damages, dust, moisture, and pests so it’s always ready to show off. EASY TO TRANSPORT These Christmas storage tree bags have 3 rubber rear wheels for fast and easy transport. It contains 2 interior adjustable straps as well with quick-release buckles that keep contents secure. RELIABLE DURABILITY Measuring 60 x 24 x 18 inches, this Christmas tree storage box will comfortably fit artificial trees up 9 feet in length (disassembled). These storage bags are made of heavy duty canvas and tear resistant, waterproof 600D oxford polyester material that will last many seasons to come. EASILY IDENTIFIED Going into the attic or garage and having to open box after to box to find your holiday decor is a real pain. This extra-large waterproof bag has a clear slot to slip a card into so you can quickly identify what's inside. EASY ACCESS A two way/dual zipper opens the bag widely for uncomplicated placement and removal. No assembly is required, just unfold, and insert your tree for effortless and trouble-free tree storage. Buy today and keep your expensive Christmas tree safely stowed all year long!
